staff.name: Rachel Rudy
staff.title: Founder and Producer
staff.description: Rachel Founded Placebo Entertainment with the hopes of replicating the indie experience before her last year on college. Drawn into games by their storytelling potential, she can often be found nose deep in a good book or playing table top RPGs.

staff.name: Caden Sheahan
staff.title: Producer, Sound Designer, and Composer
staff.description: Caden acts as Placebo Entertainments Co-Producer, Sound Designer, and Composer. He greatly enjoys the iterative process of game development and supporting the individuals that do the actual developing, and loves getting his creative juices flowing in the land of Audio. He loves getting to create games that push stories to their limits, as well as cooking, hosting events or meals, and making people cringe with his abysmal sense of humor. He hopes you enjoy Placebo Entertainment's work!

staff.name: Andrea Swihart-DeCoster
staff.title: Lead Game Engineer
staff.description:
Andrea Swihart-DeCoster is a game engineer and technical producer. She is completing a Bachelor of Science in Game Design with a minor in Computer Science. 
Outside of work, she is playing through an extensive gaming backlog, currently tackling Diablo 4. When she is not absorbed by her 3 monitors (which still isn't enough) she is probably reading or playing with her Bengal cat, Midas!

staff.name: Amanda Lardner
staff.title: Art Lead
staff.description: Amanda Lardner is a character artist from Saint Louis, Missouri. Her focus is humanoid character art and takes inspiration from various story driven games and artists across the internet.  In her free time she likes creating intricate nail art and watching various Youtube channels.

staff.name: Jacqueline Heisel
staff.title: Asset Team Lead
staff.description: Jacqueline Heisel is a Game Design student at Bradley University. In her video game-based classes she focuses on production and game design. She also enjoys making tabletop games that physically bring people together to bond and share an experience. Outside of Game Design she's a part of Bradley Univeristy's Speech Team and Improv Troupe. Be warned: she will take any opportunity to talk about robotics.

staff.name: Kyle Kotovsky
staff.title: Engine Team Lead
staff.description: Kyle Kotovsky is a senior majoring in Game Design with a focus on technical and level design. He has experience with Unreal Engine, Unity, and GameMaker. His dream is to work in the game development industry working on projects that transform perspectives and challenge players. He enjoys playing a variety of games for entertainment and inspiration with the education path of becoming a game designer being a natural choice and life long dream. Kyle is currently trying to work through his game backlog, but the multiple summer sales have unfortunately added a lot more than he can work through.

staff.name: Nick Rice
staff.title: Design Lead
staff.description: Nick Rice has an open-door, opportunistic mindset. He’s a game designer because the admissions representative at his university asked if anyone was interested in the game design major. He rock-climbed in a Kentucky gorge. He worked for a documentary company while in LA for a semester. In his free time, he enjoys baking, photography, and consuming his hoard of media.

staff.name: Marissa Moser
staff.title: Programming Lead Assistant
staff.description: Marissa Moser is currently studying Game Design at Bradley University with minors in Computer Science and Creative Writing. She has a passion for programming, specifically designing and building systems and tools. Since discovering this passion Marissa has spent her time on various teams to produce many games and experiences during the years of her study using Unity and Unreal Engine. When she is not programming, Marissa loves to read, work on her castle build in Minecraft, and play various other sandbox or puzzle games.

staff.name: Nick Grinstead
staff.title: Programmer
staff.description: Nick Grinstead is currently studying Game Design at Bradley University. He works primarily as a game programmer, focusing on systems and UI programming. Nick enjoys playing RPG and Action games as inspiration for his work. When not working on games, he enjoys drawing and going for walks. Nick is drawn to game development due to their uniqueness as an interactive medium and seeks to craft experiences where players get to tell their own stories.

staff.name: Mark Hanson
staff.title: Programmer
staff.description: Mark Hanson is a person who enjoys programming the gameplay elements of a game. Physics, puzzles, or anything to do with numbers he finds joy. Making video games has always been a dream of his since when he was younger so often he will spend multiple hours on something per day out of enjoyment of the process. He is a person of big dreams and bigger aspirations as shown in all of his previous titles.

staff.name: Brad Dixon
staff.title: Designer
staff.description: Brad Dixon is a current student enrolled at Bradley University for Game Design. He mainly works as a designer brainstorming concepts about what to include in the game. He also goes in-engine to add the works made by team members into the game. He first started making games in order to create entertaining games that others could enjoy. When not working on games, he can be seen playing tennis and Dungeons & Dragons, or he could be doing just about anything as long as it’s with friends. In his spare time, he also volunteers and helps out others.

staff.name: Caelie Joyner
staff.title: VFX Artist
staff.description: Caelie Joyner is a VFX artist at Placebo Entertainment, dabbling in concept art on the side. She is a rising senior at Bradley University in Peoria, IL. When she is not studying or adding polish to games, she can be found spacing out, replaying her favorite games, or attempting to bake something.

staff.name: Charlotte Tolly
staff.title: UX Designer
staff.description: Charlotte is an undergraduate student with a passion for design (including designing the website you're reading right now!) and creative work. She's been telling stories and making art since she was a small child, and never quite grew out of playing pretend. In her free time, you can find her scouring for the perfect font, wearing graphic eyeliner, and hosting movie marathons.

staff.name: Colin Wilcox
staff.title: General Artist
staff.description: Colin Wilcox is a student at Bradley University studying Game Art. He works pretty evenly between creating 2D and 3D art, and spends frequent time playing video games both for inspiration and for leisure. Outside of his work, Colin is a lover of board games both simple and complex, and TTRPGs like Dungeons and Dragons. He enjoys and studies Game Art specifically due to his strong belief that video games can be art, and how the art of a video game will stick with players far longer than if the art had stood on its own.

staff.name: Hayden Huber
staff.title: UI UX Designer
staff.description: Hayden Huber is a senior at Bradley University, with a major in UI/UX design and a minor in Game Design. He is from Flower Mound Texas, and loves horror games, exercise, and music. He regularly participates on campus as a tour guide, and is an active member in the Fencing club, Improv club, and UX club. Hayden loves UI design because he sees it like a puzzle, trying to find the best way to blend captivating visuals with functionality and clarity. Hayden dreams of being a UI designer at a games studio in the future, working on the same kind of projects that have brought him so much joy and excitement throughout his own life.

staff.name: Jasper Schilliro
staff.title: General Artist
staff.description: Jasper is an artist from Illinois who specializes in 3D prop and creature art. They have a passion for making lil guys and texture art, especially in a handpainted style. When they’re not crying over engine issues, they enjoy singing, cooking gluten free meals, and playing video games, board games, and Dungeons and Dragons.

staff.name: Alec Pizziferro
staff.title: Web Programmer
staff.description: Alec Pizziferro is a software developer who focuses in VR development. He specializes in physics-based mechanics and loves to teach himself all sorts of things, from engine programming and 3D renderering to carpentry and electronics. Alec has been working in the games industry for 4 years, and has mastered many tools. Outside of tech, Alec loves aquascaping and all things fishkeeping, especially keeping angelfish.
